tools.name: list_decks
tools.description: The catalog of K2 study decks: nine curated datasets spanning Japanese kanji and vocabulary, HSK Chinese, Korean Hangul, Spanish, French, classical Latin, medical Latin and nature birds. Returns each deck id (the value other tools take), what it teaches, how many entries it has, and what its fields

tools.name: search_deck
tools.description: Search one deck. `query` substring-matches the term, its reading/pronunciation, its English meanings, and its category, so "bone" finds entries glossed as bone and "ㄱ" finds that jamo. Narrow with `category` (exact, from list_decks) or `difficulty` (1-5; for the kanji deck this is the school grade).

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: One deck entry in full, matched on the exact term (the kanji, hanzi, jamo, or word itself). Case-insensitive. Returns every field the deck carries, including the deck-specific extras: stroke counts, JLPT level and a memory story (mnemonic) for kanji, component kanji for compounds, declension and Eng

tools.name: get_cube_algorithms
tools.description: Rubik's cube last-layer algorithm sets used by the K2 cube trainer: full OLL (57 cases), full PLL (21), the two-look beginner subsets, full ZBLL, and Roux CMLL (42 cases plus a two-look subset; CMLL algorithms only need to solve the corners and keep both 1x2x3 blocks). tools.name: explain_k2_algorithm
tools.description: The K2 spaced-repetition engine, described. K2 stores no review dates: each item holds a probability p that halves on a correct answer and doubles on a wrong one, and items are drawn by Monte Carlo rejection sampling, so the pool self-organizes around current weaknesses and expands when it cools. tools.name: simulate_k2_session
tools.description: Run the real K2 engine over your own items. Give it a list of terms (any strings — your flashcards, cube cases, anything), a study mode, and a sequence of answers, and it returns the p-value trajectory per answer, which items are now mastered, when the pool expanded, and the probability distribution

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: What K2 is, which apps it runs, what this server does and does not expose, and every machine-readable surface. Also returns the full capability map — every tool, prompt, and resource — so a client with a stale or tools-only roster can still see the whole surface.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_decks" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
